Name: Minecraft Paintings for Custom Furniture
Author: erasercat
Description:
[center][size=5][b]?[color=#f4cccc]Minecraft Paintings for Custom Furniture[/color]?[/b][/size]
[color=#ffe599]୨୧[/color][color=#f4cccc] Consider donating to my [url=http://ko-fi.com/erasercat]ko-fi[/url]﻿ if you enjoy my mods! [/color][color=#ffe599]୨୧[/color][color=#f4cccc]

?[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Features[/b]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Adds 20 paintings from Minecraft into Stardew Valley without replacing the original ones.
[*]They cost 100 from Robin, or 0 if you're using the furniture catalog. 
[/list]
?[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Installation[/b]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Download the latest version of [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip CF and this mod and drop them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run game using SMAPI!
[/list]
?[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Other mods seen in the pictures[/b]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2869//]Coii's Hair Sets Pack﻿[/url]﻿
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2871]Coii's All Hats Pack[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]
?[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]The paintings may turn into other items when you scroll over them, this is not an issue I can fix as it concerns the Custom Furniture mod itself.[/size]
[*][size=3]The largest paintings in Minecraft are not included, they won't fit.[/size]
[*]This mod works with SDV 1.4 and SMAPI 3.0.1.
[/list]
